locations.note: John Mullins starts in the New York subway, chasing stolen nuclear weapons.
Mullins fights through a trainyard and a working slaughterhouse in Kordofan to destroy the missile factory hidden beneath it, where the Order bought the New York gang's guns.
The hunt for the stolen warheads takes Mullins into the snow of Siberia.
A mission in Tokyo on the trail of the buyers.
Kosovo during the conflict of the late 1990s.
Mullins fights his way through Iraq on the trail of the warheads, and returns later in the chase.
Early in the hunt for the stolen nuclear material, Mullins fights his way along a train through the African bush.
The finale in Germany, the base of Dekker's Afrikaner neo-fascists.

routes.name: John Mullins
routes.note: From a hostage siege in the New York subway Mullins chases four stolen warheads across a train in Uganda, Kosovo, an island off Siberia and Iraq, then follows the Order's guns back to New York, a missile factory in Kordofan, Tokyo and Iraq to Dekker's castle in Germany.
